questions.stem: If the lines represented by the equations 3x + 4y = 12 and 6x + 8y = 24 are coincident, what is the ratio of their corresponding coefficients?
questions.solution: The lines 3x + 4y = 12 and 6x + 8y = 24 are coincident, meaning the ratios of their corresponding coefficients are equal. The ratio of the coefficients of x, y, and the constant terms is 1:2. The other options do not correctly represent the ratio of the coefficients for coincident lines.

hi.solution: समीकरण 3x + 4y = 12 और 6x + 8y = 24 की रेखाएं संपाती हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि उनके संगत गुणांकों का अनुपात समान है। x, y और अचर पदों के गुणांकों का अनुपात 1:2 है। अन्य विकल्प संपाती रेखाओं के गुणांकों के अनुपात को सही ढंग से नहीं दर्शाते हैं।

questions.stem: If the equations 3x + 2y = 7 and 6x + 4y = 14 are solved algebraically, what type of solution do they have?
questions.solution: The second equation is exactly twice the first, so the two equations are equivalent and represent the same line. This means there are infinitely many solutions. If there were no solution, the lines would be parallel. If there were one solution, the lines would intersect at one point. Two solutions is not possible for linear equations.

questions.stem: A pair of linear equations is given by 2x + 3y = 12 and 4x + 6y = 24. What can be said about the solution of this pair of equations?
questions.solution: The given equations are 2x + 3y = 12 and 4x + 6y = 24. Upon simplification, the second equation becomes 2x + 3y = 12, which is identical to the first equation. This means the two equations represent the same line, and thus, there are infinitely many solutions. The other options are incorrect because a unique solution occurs when lines intersect, no solution occurs when lines are parallel, and inconsistency refers to no solution, not infinitely many solutions.

questions.stem: The equations 2x + 3y = 6 and 4x + 6y = 12 are given. A student solves them by substitution and gets x = 3 - 1.5y. What conclusion can be drawn about the solution?
questions.solution: The second equation is exactly twice the first, so they represent the same line. When a student solves by substitution and finds an expression for x in terms of y, it indicates that the equations are dependent and have infinitely many solutions. If there were one unique solution, the substitution would have given a specific value for x and y. No solution would occur if the lines were parallel, and two solutions is not possible for linear equations.

questions.stem: Two linear equations are given by 2x + 3y = 10 and 4x + 6y = 20. A student claims that the system has infinitely many solutions, but another student argues that the system is inconsistent. Who is correct, and why?
choices: The first student is correct because the equations are identical.
The second student is correct because the equations are parallel.
Both students are correct because the equations are independent.
Neither student is correct because the equations have a unique solution.
questions.solution: The first student is correct because the second equation (4x + 6y = 20) is exactly twice the first equation (2x + 3y = 10). This means the two equations represent the same line and have infinitely many solutions. The second student is incorrect because the equations are not parallel but coincident. The other options are incorrect because the equations are not independent and do not have a unique solution.

hi.stem: 2x + 3y = 10 और 4x + 6y = 20 द्वारा दो रैखिक समीकरण दिए गए हैं। एक छात्र का कहना है कि प्रणाली के अनंत हल हैं, लेकिन एक अन्य छात्र का तर्क है कि प्रणाली असंगत है। कौन सही है और क्यों?
choices: पहला छात्र सही है क्योंकि समीकरण समान हैं।
दूसरा छात्र सही है क्योंकि समीकरण समांतर हैं।
दोनों छात्र सही हैं क्योंकि समीकरण स्वतंत्र हैं।
कोई भी छात्र सही नहीं है क्योंकि समीकरणों का अद्वितीय हल है।
hi.solution: पहला छात्र सही है क्योंकि दूसरी समीकरण (4x + 6y = 20) पहली समीकरण (2x + 3y = 10) के बिल्कुल दोगुना है। इसका अर्थ है कि दोनों समीकरण एक ही रेखा का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं और अनंत हल होते हैं। दूसरा छात्र गलत है क्योंकि समीकरण समांतर नहीं हैं बल्कि संपाती हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि समीकरण स्वतंत्र नहीं हैं और एक अद्वितीय हल नहीं है।
